Interface IOrderDraft

public interface IOrderDraft
An order that is about to be created, as listeners of PreOrderCreateEvent see and change it.

Values are checked when they are set. The limits of the server (lines and items per order, name length) and that the order keeps at least one line are checked once all listeners ran; a draft that breaks them is not created.

      List<? extends IDraftLine> lines()
      The lines of the order in their order.

      The list is a snapshot: removing a line while iterating over it is safe, and lines added later are not in it.
